images.caption: Alternate cover — black-and-white copperplate engraving
images.style_prompt: Black-and-white copperplate engraving in the manner of an 18th-century scientific engraving, purely pictorial: a tall ivory tower of learning with barred iron gates, robed professors watching anxiously from its battlements, while a great crowd of ordinary townspeople — craftsmen, engineers, clerks and laborers — marches up the hill toward the gates, led by a small mechanical scribe walking among them; fine cross-hatching throughout.

images.style_prompt: Bold screen-printed protest poster in flat red, black and cream with a grainy print texture, purely pictorial: a crowd of ordinary working people — craftsmen with tools, engineers, clerks, students — marching together toward a tall ivory tower whose iron gates are swinging open, a small friendly robot walking in their midst, robed professors peering down from the tower's battlements.
